headline: Dangote launches $2.7 billion pipeline project in Namibia
summary: Dangote has launched a N$41.6 billion (approx. US$2.7 billion) pipeline and tank farm project in Walvis Bay, Namibia. The project aims to reduce fuel prices in the region once operational.
why: Infrastructure projects of this scale are significant for regional energy security and can alter the competitive landscape for fuel distribution in Southern Africa.
